svg.title: Yellow/Red
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study after an inspected primary museum photograph. Geometry approximate; vivid screen colour not calibrated. Observed two vertical colour areas on rectangular canvas; photographic perspective rectified. Museum publishes framed size only, so physical scale is disabled.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.walkerart.org/collections/artwork/yellow-red/; source object 1994.215; inspected 2026-10-27; hand-authored approximation.
